capabilities: Check GitHub for community plugin and theme updates on demand
Select which updates to install from a checkbox dialog
Restore the previous files of an installed update
Ignore updates so they are not offered again
View release notes and remaining GitHub API quota
extras: No-warranty MIT disclaimer is included; the author asks for donations via Buy Me a Coffee; the UI ships in ten languages. No support for sideloaded plugins outside the community directory or themes on GitHub guesses.
problem: Obsidian updates plugins and themes without letting you review each release first or roll back a bad update.

relations.evidence: Lazy Loader: read its settings so delayed items are not treated as disabled

summary: Manual update checker that scans GitHub for community plugin and theme updates on demand and installs only the ones you select.
